about: Sparring M2 run 3. Run 2 failed in training: A2 was stopped by hand at 266 iterations, and its restart (run 2b) was stopped by its own predeclared rule E3 at iteration 100 (action std 0.87 > 0.85). Run 3 keeps run 2b's environment and warm start bit for bit and changes one PPO setting for the run-3 tasks: entropy_coef 0.01 -> 0.003, so that the action std stays in run 1's learning band instead of climbing at Adam's maximum rate. Eval, seeds, selection, statistics and the pass rule are run 2's.
written: 2026-10-29, before any run-3 code ran on GPU; after every log listed in test_integrity.disclosures was seen
supersedes: none. prereg_m2_run2.json (with its amendment) stays run 2's record: failed in training, no run-2 eval, no selection file. prereg_m2.json stays run 1's.

It is written to params/agent.yaml (algorithm.entropy_coef), and the pod's smoke refuses to train unless both smoke runs' agent.yaml say 'entropy_coef: 0.003'. Every other PPO setting is the R1 cfg's (see unchanged).

why.mechanism: rsl_rl 5.0.1: the action std is a free, unclamped (24,) nn.Parameter (distribution.py:156-157); loss = surrogate + value - entropy_coef x entropy (ppo.py:313); advantages are normalised per batch (ppo.py:208-209), the entropy bonus is not; one Adam over actor and critic, 5 epochs x 4 minibatches per iteration. Adam removes the gradient's scale, so the std moves 20 lr f(c + rho) per iteration, f(x) = x / sqrt(x^2 + 0.0104^2) (0.0104 = sqrt(2 / 18432), the minibatch noise), with rho = -H sigma^2 / sigma_A the surrogate's restoring pull and sigma_A the raw advantage std (sqrt value loss). Equilibrium sigma* = sqrt(c sigma_A / H). At c 0.01 and lr 2.1e-4 the ceiling 20 lr f(0.01) = 0.0029 per iteration is the rise seen in run 2b.
why.evidence: H is nearly one constant over every log: 0.0060 (run 1 A), 0.0057 (B), 0.0059 (Blind), 0.0069 (the warm start's own run), 0.0077 (A2b). The law replays run 1 A with its own lr and value-loss path to 0.01 (0.711 / 0.765 / 0.807 / 0.762 at 50 / 100 / 200 / 1499 vs observed 0.719 / 0.773 / 0.807 / 0.764) and A2b's 0.874 at 100. The alive bonus widened the advantages (value loss 1.3-2.1 in A2b vs 0.52-0.60 in A2), weakening the normalised restoring pull by about 20% and raising the equilibrium at c 0.01 to 1.0-1.37. Exploration above the warm start's std was not rewarded: rho < 0 in every 20-iteration window after the first, in every run, and model_7600's Adam state was still pushing the std up in 23 of 24 dimensions.
why.not_learning: Neither A2 nor A2b showed a defensive trend: A2b's clean head hits rose 10.5 -> 12.5 per min (iterations 20-39 -> 100-107), blocked share stayed at 0.54, spar_block fell 0.209 -> 0.198 per live s, fall hazard doubled 0.013 -> 0.027 per live s while std rose 0.73 -> 0.88; what it learned was staying in the ring (ring_out hazard 0.170 -> 0.112 per live s). Run 1 A cut clean head hits after iteration 40 by backing away, with its blocked share falling 0.41 -> 0.23 (iterations 21-40 -> 1481-1500). Run 3 does not claim to fix credit assignment for blocking: it removes the std failure so that the question can be asked over 1500 iterations.
why.source: scratchpad m1m2/run3/diag_std/NOTES.md (model.py, windows.py, adam_std.py), run3/diag_knobs/NOTES.md, run3/design_entropy (analyze.py), run3/judge (pred3.py, probe_sparring_r3.py)

predicted.std: the law above, lr 2.1e-4, from 0.6366, H 0.006-0.0077, sigma_A held at 0.88 (A2's level) to 1.47 (A2b's first iterations), plus the warm start's push: every run so far started 0.007-0.023 above the law at iteration 20 from the same std and Adam state, so the excess is task-driven (a gradient push), not the Adam second moment; modelled as +0.0097 on c over the first 20 iterations it reproduces A2b's 0.708 / 0.780 at 20 / 50, adds about 0.04-0.05 at 50 and fades (+0.01 by 500). Predicted (the learn review's model, run3/rev_learn/kick_model.out): about 0.70-0.71 at 50, 0.70-0.725 at 100, 0.69-0.73 at 150, 0.67-0.77 at 500; with sigma_A held at 0.88-1.47 the envelope is 0.68-0.71 at 50, 0.66-0.73 at 100, 0.64-0.74 at 150, 0.62-0.78 at 300, 0.60-0.81 at 500, 0.59-0.85 at 1500. The law alone (no push) gives 0.63-0.66 at 50, 0.62-0.69 at 100, 0.60-0.76 at 300, 0.59-0.80 at 500. At c 0.01 the same law gives 0.74-0.79 at 50 and 0.82-0.91 at 100 (A2b observed 0.78 / 0.874).
predicted.rates_per_live_s: A2b's windows 20-39 / 80-99 moved to the predicted std with the A2 + A2b smoothness slope (-4.12 per std^2; action_rate's pure noise floor -2.42 std^2): at std 0.65 / 0.70 / 0.75 the edge rate (every term but spar_ring and is_terminated) is +2.8 to +3.2 / +2.5 to +3.0 / +2.2 to +2.7, the mean rate (every term but is_terminated) +4.6 to +5.1 / +4.4 to +4.8 / +4.1 to +4.5, action_rate's noise floor -1.02 / -1.19 / -1.36 (A2b at 0.87: edge +1.50, noise floor -1.83).
predicted.termination: a fall or ring_out costs is_terminated's 4 plus about 2 s of the forfeited live rate (gamma 0.99 per 0.02 s): about 8.4 to 10.4 at std 0.65-0.75 (A2b at 0.87: about 7; A2 without the alive bonus at 0.94: ending paid about +2). No termination is predicted to pay anywhere in the ring.
predicted.not_predicted: learning gains: the law has no exploration-benefit term, and no number here predicts blocking

early_stop.rule: python gpu/sparring_task.py watch --rule 3 (WATCH3; exit 3 = stop), applied by the pod to A3 and A3s at iterations 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, ..., 1500, counted from the run's first logged iteration, on the 20 iterations ending there. Stop if any of: E1 the median over the window of the per-iteration edge rate (every logged Episode_Reward term except spar_ring and is_terminated, x 20 / (that iteration's Mean episode length x 0.02)) is below +1.0 per live s; E2 the termination hazard (window mean of ring_out + fell_over + nan per step, / (3072 x 0.02)) is above 0.21 at 50, 0.18 at 100, 0.17 at 150 and 200, 0.16 from 300; E3 the iteration's Mean action std (2 dp, as logged) is above 0.76 at 50, 0.77 at 100, 0.80 at 150 and 200, 0.85 at 300 and 400, 0.90 from 500; E4 from 500, unless the window mean of Metrics/attack/blocked_share is at least 0.02 above its mean over iterations 31-50: the window's clean head hits per live minute (time-weighted: -sum of Episode_Reward/spar_head_clean x 20 / (sum of Mean episode length x 0.02) x 60 / 0.8, where 0.8 = 40 x 0.02 is one clean head hit's reward) are above 1.0 x the same over iterations 31-50 (a zero or missing reference counts as no fewer head hits). A missing metric counts as no progress on its part. The 1500 check is reported, never a stop (training is done); a watch error in A3 or A3s is a stop.
early_stop.derivation: E1: the predicted edge rate at std 0.65-0.75 is +2.2 to +3.2; at +1.0 a termination still costs about 6, so only a slide gets there (A2b +1.50 at std 0.87). The median, not the mean: run 1 A's window to 1000 holds one blown-up iteration (window mean -216 per live s; median -1.14, as in the windows to 900 / 1100: -1.12 / -1.13). E2: A2 0.171 / 0.153 / 0.162 / 0.182 and A2b 0.173 / 0.144 per live s at 50 / 100 / 150 / 200; the fall part shrinks with the std. A2's slide stops at 200; 0.16 from 300 sits above A2b's 0.112 ring-out level by 107 plus its 0.025 falls. E3: the law's highest path (H 0.006, sigma_A held at 1.47) with the warm start's push (+0.0097 on c over the first 20 iterations, fitted to A2b's 0.708 / 0.780 at 20 / 50) is 0.71 / 0.73 / 0.74 / 0.78 / 0.81 at 50 / 100 / 150 / 300 / 500 and 0.85 at 1500; each limit covers it plus the log's 2 dp (margins 0.04-0.09); c 0.01 paths (a wiring failure the smoke missed) give 0.74-0.79 at 50 and 0.82-0.91 at 100, so they stop by 100 at the latest (A2b: 0.78 at 50). Late on, E1 and E2 price the noise directly, so E3 relaxes to WATCH's late bar 0.90. E4: Metrics/attack/head_clean_pm is a mean over the episodes that ended of hits / that episode's minutes, so it rises with episode length alone (A2b: 0.82 -> 0.95 of the time-weighted rate as episodes went 226 -> 333 steps); E4 reads the time-weighted rate instead. On it, run 1 A / B / Blind were at 0.35 / 0.21 / 0.42 of their 31-50 rate at 500 (by backing away; their blocked share fell 0.13 / 0.15 / 0.10), A2 at 0.93 at 200 (blocked share +0.010) and A2b at 1.08 at 100 (blocked share -0.009) as it learned to stay in the ring. Staying in reach raises the hits taken per live minute, so a ring-keeping run that turns landings into blocks may show no fewer hits by 500; the blocked share was flat across episode length and std in A2 and A2b (0.535-0.570) with a 20-window standard error of 0.003-0.004, so a gain of 0.02 (about 3.5 standard errors of the difference) counts as progress on its own. A run with neither has shown no defensive progress, and the val screen needs head clean R_warm <= 0.80.
early_stop.replays: On the real logs (judge/probe_sparring_r3.py): A2b stops at 50 on E3 alone (0.78 > 0.76; WATCH let it through to 100); A2 stops at 100 on E3 (0.82 > 0.77) and E2 alone would also stop it at 200 (0.182; E3 0.91 trips too); run 1 A / B / Blind (c 0.01, no ring) stop on E3, never trip E2 and never trip E4 at 500-1500 (time-weighted ratio <= 0.42). Applied off-rule at its last check, E4 would stop A2b (hits 1.08 x, blocked share -0.009). A synthetic run on the pushed law's highest std path with A2b's falling hazard, lengthening episodes and falling head hits is never stopped, and one whose head hits rise 5% while its blocked share gains 0.03 is not stopped by E4 (tests/test_sparring_r2.py test_watch3_rules).
early_stop.consequences: as the run-2b amendment's: A3 stopped: run 3 ends there (no blind3, no A3s, no selection, no eval), reported as failing in training with the stopping criterion. A3s stopped: not a candidate, the screen runs on A3 alone. blind3 is watched and reported but never stopped (the control always trains 1500 iterations). Stopped runs are exported only as policy_mjlab_<run>_stopped for diagnosis and are never evaluated.

eval.script: scripts/eval_opponent.py --tier hard_r2 --no_pushes --hits 1 --keypoints truth; unaimed first, then --aim chosen in the same --out
eval.val: --split val --reps 32 (kfab_204 x 4 distances x 32 = 128 bouts; seeds 21000-21127); controllers guard_fw_r, A3, A3s (if trained and not stopped), blind3 (reported)
eval.test: --split test --reps 16 --run 3 (kfab_202, kfab_205 x 4 x 16 = 128; seeds 22000-22127), once, guard_fw_r + selected + blind3 in one invocation; refused unless m2_run3_selection.json has go = true against this file's current hash, and refused if a hard_r2 test raw file exists in any other --out under results/eval_opponent (searched recursively)
eval.roles: scripts/m2_verdict.py --run 3 uses run 2's protocol with A3 / A3s / blind3 in the roles A2 / A2s / blind2; only run-3 names match (a3, spar_a3, block3_a; a3s, spar_a3s, block3_a_s, block3_as; blind3, spar_blind3, block3_blind)

selection.rule: On val, aimed: candidates A3 and A3s qualify with survival >= 0.95, survival_in_ring drop vs guard_fw_r <= 0.05, and head-clean R_warm (point) <= 0.80. Among qualifiers, the lower exposure-weighted head clean/min; a difference < 0.1/min picks A3. No qualifier: go = false, the test is not run, run 3 is reported as failing at the screen.
selection.twin: blind3 for either; for A3s it is not seed-matched (reported)

statistics: identical to prereg_m2_run2.json statistics (= prereg_m2.json's), source raw_test_hard_r2_nohits_aim.json in results/eval_opponent/m2r3
rule: identical to prereg_m2_run2.json rule (head_vs_warm R <= 0.60 and CI upper < 0.80; head_vs_blind CI upper < 0.90; torso R <= 1.5; survival >= 0.95; ring drop <= 0.05; all five)
reported_regardless: prereg_m2_run2.json's list, plus: the Mean action std trajectory against the predicted band (and the per-joint std of every saved checkpoint, legs vs arms), the edge / mean live rates, hazards, head clean / min (Metrics/attack/head_clean_pm and E4's time-weighted clean head hits per live minute), the window mean of Metrics/attack/blocked_share and Episode_Reward/spar_block per live second (x 20 / (Mean episode length x 0.02)) per 20-iteration window, every WATCH3 output, and A3's first 100 iterations against A2b's log (same seed, env and warm start; entropy_coef the only difference)

rejected.entropy_coef_0.005: the law gives 0.68-0.75 at 100, 0.73-0.92 at 300 and 0.76-1.11 at equilibrium for sigma_A 0.88-1.47: run 2b again, more slowly
rejected.entropy_coef_0.001_or_0: 0.46-0.58 (0.001) and 0.38-0.49 (0) at 300, 0.34-0.51 and 0.15-0.25 at 1500: the std decays out of every observed regime
rejected.std_reset_widen3: rescaling the warm start's std 0.6366 -> 0.65 and zeroing its Adam state moves the trajectory by at most 0.012 and would not remove the warm start's push (task-driven: the same Adam state gave +0.007 to +0.023 at 20 across runs); it would add a second difference from A2b and a checkpoint edit, so the warm start stays run 2b's
rejected.hard_clamp: a GaussianDistribution subclass projecting std_param onto [0.20, 0.80] (design_clamp) bounds the std by construction but pins it at 0.80 (more noise than predicted here: action_rate floor -1.55 per live s), passes a class object through tyro and rsl_rl on the pod (verified only with tyro 1.0.16) and is invisible in params/agent.yaml; kept as the fallback if run 3's std leaves the band
rejected.noise_refund_without_alive: design_decouple: keep action_rate on sampled actions, add a constant refund 2.42 std^2 per live s, drop spar_alive, cap the std at 0.80. Sound, but three changes at once, a new reward term and module state on the pod, and the edge rate falls to about -0.5 to 0 per live s, leaving a termination only 3.1-3.9 worse than staying at the ring edge (run 2b: about 7)
rejected.freeze_std: exact but removes all adaptation; the per-joint std (legs 0.51-0.64, arms 0.62-0.74) could no longer shrink where noise costs falls
rejected.drop_alive_bonus: run 2 showed that ending pays without it once the std rose (edge -3.0 per live s at 0.94)

Remaining cap about 8.7 USD (RunPod balance 7.03 USD).
